title: Ghost proxy: tenant-aware shadow proxy with quarantine & budget sentinel
creator: Mariana López
description: Motivation: we need a production-safe shadow/mirroring pipeline that duplicates live requests for canary evaluation and offline scoring without exposing tenants to unbounded cost or noisy failures. The Ghost Proxy is a lightweight request duplicator placed at the edge gateway. It provides tenant-aware quotas, adaptive sampling, and an automated quarantine mechanism for tenants that repeatedly cause high downstream cost or error rates. The component must integrate with the rollout controller to provide correlation metrics for canary and A/B tests and emit signals for auto-rollback when regressions are detected. Key constraints: must add minimal p99 latency (<= 3ms), honor tenant data isolation, and provide auditable cost attribution per shadowed token.
acceptance_criteria: Ghost Proxy duplicates requests to a shadow runtime asynchronously without increasing the production response p99 by more than 3ms for 99% of traffic
Per-tenant shadow budget is enforced: once a tenant's budget is exhausted the proxy drops shadow copies for that tenant and emits a budget-exhausted metric
Adaptive sampling reduces shadowed rate automatically for tenants with rising error or cost profiles and increases for low-risk tenants according to configurable policy
Quarantine mode isolates traffic for tenants that exceed configurable error/cost thresholds and stores a configurable sample of payloads for review
Rollout controller receives correlated request IDs and can compute canary-vs-control divergence metrics; auto-rollback trigger fires when divergence > threshold for N minutes
End-to-end dashboards show token-level cost for shadow traffic, per-tenant quotas, quarantine events, and sampling rate changes
Unit + integration tests for sampling, budget enforcement, quarantine, and metric emission exist and run in CI
implementation_notes: Architecture: Ghost Proxy as a sidecar-like service inside the edge gateway cluster. Handles sync duplication for sampled requests (returns original response quickly) and async fanout for bulk shadowing.
Budget Sentinel: Redis-backed token buckets per tenant with a leaky replenish policy. Budget decisions are local-first with periodic reconciliation against authoritative billing ledger.
Adaptive sampling: sliding window estimator using recent error-rate and cost-per-request; decay factor to avoid oscillation; configurable min/max sampling per tenant.
Quarantine: when triggered, mark tenant in the routing table with quarantine flag -> future requests still served but shadow copies suppressed and a small sample archived to S3 for manual inspection.
Metrics: emit correlation_id, tenant_id, shadow_decision, sampled_reason, token_count, cost_estimate, latency_shadow, and quarantine_reason via our observability pipeline.
Safety hooks: circuit-breaker callbacks to rollout controller and an emergency 'drain-shadow' admin API to disable shadowing globally or per-tenant.

Integration: ties into rollout-controller APIs for canary correlation and to billing pipeline for cost attribution of shadow tokens. Also requires small schema addition to Trace and Span metadata for 'ghost.shadow_id'.
